claims.text: A whistleblower complaint to SEBI alleged conflict of interest in ICICI Bank's loan to Videocon Group linked to Kochhar's husband
ICICI's board asked Kochhar to proceed on leave pending an internal investigation
Kochhar resigned as MD and CEO on October 4, 2018; Sandeep Bakhshi was named successor
ICICI Bank terminated Kochhar's employment for cause in January 2019 and clawed back bonuses
The CBI filed a charge sheet against Kochhar in September 2020 for alleged criminal conspiracy and cheating

outcome.summary: Kochhar resigned as ICICI Bank CEO in October 2018 and was later terminated 'for cause' in January 2019. The bank clawed back her bonuses and perquisites. The CBI filed a charge sheet against her in 2020. The matter remains pending in Indian courts.

timeline.event: Arvind Gupta's complaint to SEBI alleges conflict of interest in ICICI Bank's Rs 3,250 crore loan to Videocon Group
ICICI Bank board asks Kochhar to proceed on leave pending investigation
Kochhar resigns as MD and CEO; Sandeep Bakhshi appointed as successor
ICICI Bank terminates Kochhar's employment 'for cause' and claws back her bonuses
CBI files charge sheet against Kochhar and others for alleged criminal conspiracy and cheating

title: Chanda Kochhar resigns as ICICI Bank CEO
trigger: Allegations of conflict of interest in ICICI Bank's loan to the Videocon Group, linked to Kochhar's husband's business, led the board to ask for her resignation.
